cases.sentence: «Когда вы станете раздавать по жребию наделы, выделите для Господа часть земли как ___, 25 000 локтей в длину и 20 000 в ширину.

cases.translation: “ ‘ “Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to Yahweh, a holy portion of the land. The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its border all around.
